Hi Chris,

 

I am trying to investigate group difference in graph level as in the 'brainGraph_UserGuide'. I can calculate the ‘Lp’, ‘Cp’, E.global’, ‘modality’, ‘assortativity’ and ‘assortativity.lobe’. However, I got following errors for some parameters (max.comp, clique.num, num.tri, diameter, transitivity, asymm, num.hubs, E.local, vulnerability). I am using the following procedure:

 
____________________________________
 
exclude.subs <- NULL
use.mean <- FALSE 
 
init.vars <- brainGraph_init(atlas='destrieux', densities=seq(0.05, 0.5, 0.01),
                datadir=datadir, modality='thickness',
                       exclude.subs=exclude.subs, use.mean=use.mean)
 
lapply(seq_along(init.vars), function(x)
       assign(names(init.vars)[x], eval(init.vars[[x]]), envir=.GlobalEnv))
               
N <- which(abs(densities - 0.3) < 0.001)
 
all.dat.resids <- get.resid(all.dat.tidy, covars, exclude='Group')
resids.all <- all.dat.resids$resids.all
formulas <- all.dat.resids$formulas
resids.all <- all.dat.resids$resids.all
 
corrs <- lapply(groups, function(x)
                    lapply(densities, function(y)
                           corr.matrix(resids.all[x], density=y)))
                               
g <- lapply(corrs, lapply, function(x)
        graph_from_adjacency_matrix(x$r.thresh, mode='undirected', diag=F))
                       
g <- Map(function(x, y) llply(x, set.brainGraph.attributes, atlas=atlas,
                       modality=modality, group=y, .progress='text'),
                               g, as.list(groups))
kNumPerms <- 1e4
 
myPerms <- permute::shuffleSet(n=nrow(resids.all), nset=kNumPerms)
 
perms.all <- plyr::adply(densities, .margins=1, function(x)
               permute.group(myPerms, x, resids.all, 'graph', atlas),
                       .progress='text',.id=NULL)
 
setDT(perms.all)
dim(perms.all)
 
permPlot <- plot_perm_diffs(g[[1]], g[[2]], perms.all, 'num.hubs', level='graph',
               groups=groups, alternative='less',
               ylabel='Number of Hubs')
 
>>Error in plot_perm_diffs(g[[1]], g[[2]], perms.all, "num.hubs", level = "graph",  : 
  Measure "num.hubs" is not valid!
 
________________________________

Is there a problem about the procedure? 
 
Thanks in advance.
Onur

parts:
Hi Onur,
For permutation testing, "num.hubs" isn't one of the defaults that is calculated.
In the User Guide in Chapter 5.2.4 there is an example custom function. You can paste that code into R, run the example, and then add "num.hubs" to the "perms.all" data.table:
perms.all$num.hubs <- perms.hub.diffs$num.hubs

And then your code should work. You may want to test it out with a low number of permutations first to see that it runs without error.
Chris

parts:
No, sorry that is a "bug". In the sense that, there is no way for the code to look at the vertex measure that was used in the data.table "perms.btwn" (because the column names represent the brain regions). So while your function call does not throw any errors, what you are seeing in the plot is the comparison of the *permuted betweenness centrality differences* and the *observed eigenvector centrality differences*.

To get permutation differences in vertex eigenvector centrality, you can pass this function; please let me know if there is an error as I have not tested it.

evcent.diffs.perm <- function(g1, g2, density) {
  ev.diff <- centr_eigen(g1)$vector - centr_eigen(g2)$vector
  tmp <- as.data.table(cbind(density, t(ev.diff)))
}

The current default (hard-coded) vertex-level measures in "permute.group" are: btwn.cent, vulnerability, degree, E.nodal, knn, transitivity
I would like to ultimately either include more, or write the code in such a way that it can handle multiple options, but that would be tricky. The former solution is simpler but I will not get to it for several days. The temp function above will work just the same.

Chris

Hi Ozgun et al., I have figured out the problem.

Since v1.0.0, I combined "permute.group" and "permute.group.auc". This requires a change to the structure of custom functions. I forgot to update the User Guide accordingly. For EV and closeness centralities, the code would be:

evcent.diffs.perm <- function(g, densities) {
  meas.list <- lapply(g, function(x) t(sapply(x, function(y) centr_eigen(y)$vector)))
  my.diff <- sapply(seq_along(V(g[[1]][[1]])), function(x)
      brainGraph:::auc_diff(densities, cbind(meas.list[[1]][, x], meas.list[[2]][, x])))
  tmp <- as.data.table(t(my.diff))
  setnames(tmp, 1:ncol(tmp), V(g[[1]][[1]])$name)
  return(tmp)
}

For closeness, replace "centr_eigen(y)$vector" with "centr_clo(y)$res" in the function (and be sure to change the function name, accordingly).

In the future I will likely make this a much easier process. And probably I will add these 2 measures to the hard-coded version, so then you can just type measure="ev.cent", for example.

Chris

No, sorry that is a "bug". In the sense that, there is no way for the code to look at the vertex measure that was used in the data.table "perms.btwn" (because the column names represent the brain regions). So while your function call does not throw any errors, what you are seeing in the plot is the comparison of the *permuted betweenness centrality differences* and the *observed eigenvector centrality differences*.

To get permutation differences in vertex eigenvector centrality, you can pass this function; please let me know if there is an error as I have not tested it.

evcent.diffs.perm <- function(g1, g2, density) {
  ev.diff <- centr_eigen(g1)$vector - centr_eigen(g2)$vector
  tmp <- as.data.table(cbind(density, t(ev.diff)))
}
